summary: Jersey Central Power & Light Co filed a Form 8-K reporting the issuance of $350 million aggregate principal amount of 4.600% Senior Notes due 2030 under a purchase agreement dated May 4, 2026. The notes are senior unsecured general obligations, priced at par with a make-whole call provision, and mature January 15, 2030. Proceeds are for refinancing debt, capex, and general corporate purposes. The offering was exempt from registration under Rule 144A/Regulation S. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No special-situation attributes exist.
